body.x: GT Telecom(CEO Ju-Won Heo, www.gttelecom.co.kr)showed off Bluetooth Headset MobiFren 'GBH-S500' tuned by famous musician Don Spike at '2014 International CES', the biggest IT∙appliances show held in Las Vegas, U.S. from January 7th to 10th.

With outstandingly differentiated design, 'GBH-S500' features premium Hi-Fi sound that is tuned by Don Spike in production and many abilities such as Alam on incoming call, Phone loss prevention mode, Android Application and Voice prompt.

The biggest point of the stereo headset is its sound quality which is incomparable to any other cable earphones. According to the officials, it realizes high quality clean sound with choosing from the 5 EQ modes.

GT Telecom is specialized in producing Bluetooth telecommunication products such as Bluetooth Headset, Bluetooth Handsfree Car Kit, Bluetooth Handsfree, Easy Mobilyzer, Mono Bluetooth Headset, Stereo Bluetooth Headset and Wireless FM Transmitter. Showing off its excellent techniques based on many manufactural experiences, GT Telecom has been actively expanding the business in Japan, Europe, North America and Brazil as well as in Korea.

"In order to support to launch in North American market, we will focus on discovering various distributors and agents from North, Middle and South America during this CES, " said, GT Telecom CEO Ju-Won Heo "Since it got great success in Europe and Japan as our products have unique design, various abilities and quality sound, they are expected to have good result in North American market, as well." he added his expectation.

'CES(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases 2,500 ~ 3,200 exhibitors in every kind of electronic appliance. More than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries come to the show.
